title: Studying for a Certification Exam
paragraphs: Hana wants a promotion at work. First, she must pass a work exam. She needs to study subjects that she has not studied since university.
Hana works all day and studies in the evening. By the third week, she feels very tired. She thinks about taking the exam at a later time.
Her husband tells her to keep the exam date. For a short time, he does more work at home. Hana can then use her evening time to study.
On exam day, Hana passes. Later, she sees that short study times each day helped her more than she expected.
